pollInterval.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: Read device state over your local network.

model.title: Device model
model.description: Model identifier from Xiaomi Home. The E10 requires Matter enabled in Homebridge 2.4+ and separate Matter pairing in Apple Home.

host.title: Local IPv4 address
host.description: For example, 192.168.1.50. Reserve this address for the device in your router.

token.title: Local device token
token.description: 32 hexadecimal characters. The token is stored in your Homebridge configuration.

did.title: Xiaomi device ID (optional)
did.description: Filled in during cloud import. Keep this value when changing the IP address.

id.title: Stable identifier (optional)
id.description: For manual setup, enter a value such as living-room-purifier to preserve the device in Apple Home if its IP changes. Keep this identifier unchanged.

exposeDisplay.title: Expose purifier display in Apple Home
exposeDisplay.description: Air purifiers only. Adds a light control for the display: 0% Off, 50% Dim, 100% On. Apple Home may include it in lighting commands. Disabled by default; it does not control the purifier motor.
